rules: high or extreme attribute modifier matching its best skills; typically high Reflex or Will and low Fortitude; many skills at moderate or high and potentially one or two extreme skills; at least one special ability to use the creature's skills in combat

notes.attributes: High or extreme Wisdom, the attribute of its best skills.
notes.defense: Typically high Reflex or Will (set: high Will) and low Fortitude.
notes.skills: Many skills moderate or high, one or two extreme (set: the Wisdom skills high, Nature extreme).
notes.specials: At least one special ability that uses its skills in combat.
